canonical_definition: Frozen .bin and .hex files; C arrays must contain the same exact bytes.

generation.crypto: xorshift32, unsigned modulo2^32, seed0x1A2B3C4D, shifts13left/17right/5left, emit lowbyte after each full update,2048updates
generation.dsp: u[n]=floor(128+100*sin(2*pi*n/128)+0.5),n0..127; period128 repeated16times; frozen byte table is authoritative
